experiences.name: Hoan Kiem Lake & Old Quarter Street Food Walk
experiences.description: Explore Hanoi's iconic Old Quarter on foot, sampling iconic street foods like Bun Cha, Banh Mi, and Egg Coffee from vendors and tiny local eateries clustered around Hoan Kiem Lake. Stay in a hostel within the Old Quarter itself to walk to every stall.
experiences.location: Old Quarter, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi

experiences.name: Hoi An Ancient Town Lantern & Cuisine Experience
experiences.description: Wander the UNESCO-listed Ancient Town of Hoi An, visit tailor shops, temples, and the famous covered Japanese Bridge, then join a local cooking class to learn White Rose Dumplings and Cao Lau. Book accommodation on Tran Phu Street to be steps from all activity hubs.
experiences.location: Ancient Town, Hoi An, Quang Nam Province

experiences.name: Mekong Delta Local Market & Sampan Boat Tour
experiences.description: Take a budget group day tour from Ben Tre town into the Mekong Delta, riding sampan boats through narrow canals, visiting floating markets, coconut candy workshops, and eating fresh river fish with locals. Stay in Ben Tre town to minimize transfer costs.
experiences.location: Ben Tre, Mekong Delta, Southern Vietnam

experiences.name: Bui Vien Walking Street Night Food & Backpacker Scene
experiences.description: Dive into Ho Chi Minh City's legendary backpacker street, Bui Vien, sampling Banh Trang Tron (rice paper salad), grilled skewers, and fresh spring rolls from street carts. The street is lined with budget hostels so staying here puts you at the center of the action.
experiences.location: Bui Vien Street, Pham Ngu Lao Backpacker District, Ho Chi Minh City

experiences.name: Phong Nha Cave Trekking & Jungle Camping
experiences.description: Join a budget group trekking tour into Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park, exploring Paradise Cave or the Dark Cave by kayak and zip line, then camp overnight near the jungle entrance. Stay at one of the many backpacker hostels in Phong Nha village, a 5-minute bike ride from the park gate.
experiences.location: Phong Nha Village, Bo Trach District, Quang Binh Province
